verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch docs reference scripting capabilities for 'pre-request logic and test cases' and a CLI 'hopp test' command that can generate JUnit reports for collection runs, implying support for test assertions, but no evidence details how assertions target response status, body, or headers specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of assertion syntax (pw.expect-style) for status/body/headers, independent hands-on confirmation of test script execution.
